module_summary: Sequential 8x8 signed shift-and-add multiplier: reset loads sign-extended operands, then for 16 cycles a bit-index counter tests one multiplier bit and adds the left-shifting multiplicand into the product register, raising done when finished.

anchors.name: n3_520
anchors.why: 16-bit product accumulator output, adds shifted multiplicand when indexed multiplier bit set.

anchors.name: n1_13b
anchors.why: Bit index/iteration counter sequencing 16 steps, selects multiplier bit, then triggers done.

anchors.name: n2_113
anchors.why: Signed multiplier operand, sign-extended into the multiplier register at reset.

anchors.name: n6_144
anchors.why: Signed multiplicand operand, sign-extended into the shifting multiplicand register.

anchors.name: n4_506
anchors.why: Held sign-extended multiplier whose indexed bit gates each add.

anchors.name: n5_4b3
anchors.why: Multiplicand register shifted left every iteration and added to product.

anchors.name: n9_462
anchors.why: Done level set once the counter reaches 16.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Operand registers and conditional accumulate into product.
